# Exact source corpus for the 2026-10-27 retrieval review

These four unchanged files were explicitly included at the user's request to reproduce the test corpus without uncommitted local files or the original test deployment. [manifest.json](manifest.json) records byte sizes and SHA-256 hashes; they match the original hashes in the paired ingestion record.

- `01-allotment-seasonal-planting-guide.docx`: synthetic seasonal recommendations and an embedded site plan. It was generated by `scripts/sample_docs/build.py`; source definitions/rendering and image generation are already committed.
- `12-wetland-restoration-project.pptx`: synthetic restoration slides/notes and a trail-sign picture, from the same committed generator.
- `01-rainfall-bar-chart.png`: synthetic labelled monthly chart, from `scripts/sample_docs/images.py`.
- `New-Future-Of-Work-Report-2025.pdf`: the user-supplied Microsoft report used in the tests, preserved unchanged with its own attribution/rights statements. Its inclusion as test input does not assert that its authors endorse this implementation or grant new reuse rights.

These are regression/development inputs, not extra runtime dependencies and not data to upload automatically during unit tests. Re-ingesting them invokes the deployment's ordinary extraction/model services and has a cost. The existing synthetic generators can create a wider corpus; this exact subset preserves byte-level comparison for these recorded experiments.

Questions, source checks, observed answers, figures, diagnostic outputs and replay setup: [evidence pack](../../../docs/testing/2026-10-27/README.md). Implementation and future development: [current retrieval contract](../../../docs/agent-retrieval.md) and [build plan](../../../docs/build-plan.md).
